description: Declared mutants of the passes' names, debug groups, CPU times and the frames' GPU time (render-pipeline declaration section 15, v8-arch-gyo2-render-a3; 判定 T1 to T4; revision 15.8). One per independently wrong decision (tests/common/mutation/README.md, criteria 1 to 3 and 9). The batch changes no Design Invariant (A3 is a lower-tier batch), so every guard is a 判定 or the revision of section 15. tm-label-*, tm-timing-* (but tm-timing-not-begun and tm-timing-none-given) need no GPU (label cpu; tm-label-kind-wrong runs render.data); the other tm-* need a GPU (label gpu, sdl_gpu.timing); tm-status-timing-not-given runs sdl_gpu.frames, which shows a window (not run by the A3 card: L1 runs the case, not the mutants). Retired in 15.8: tm-groups-carried-over (the reset moved into BeginTiming: tm-timing-groups-not-reset), tm-capture-not-tracked (Submit and Capture hand through one function: tm-hand-not-tracked), tm-submit-not-tracked (the same Hand; and sdl_gpu.frames no longer requires a frame seen done on the window, design review M7: nothing waits for it). Not added (with the reason): a fence taken as done before it is signaled (Capture waits for its fence before looking, so no case without a window tells it apart); the fences let go at the device's end (FramesInFlight::Clear, seen by [tm-seen-cleared] since 15.9; no mutant added in a renaming batch); Submit looking at the fences before the swapchain's wait (the bound only gets looser, by the wait: not seen from outside); SDL_PushGPUDebugGroup alone removed (the count is the DebugGroup's own: only a capture tool sees the call, 15.8 N2); the debug group's name in a capture tool (CI has no capture tool: only the count is checked, 15.4). 15.9 (renaming, the user's S1 = (ii)): tm-gpu-older-kept and tm-gpu-time-zero moved with the account into FramesInFlight.hpp and to its CPU case (scripted times); tm-hand-not-tracked's find follows FramesInFlight::Hand; one added, tm-seen-after-dropped, for the interval's new lower bound.

mutants.what: 15.3 (1): a pass's name leaves out its place, so two passes alike share a name
15.3 (1): a pass's name says main whatever its target
15.3 (1): a full-screen pass's name leaves out its shader
15.8 (S3, M4): a pass's kind is named as another kind (render's PassKindName; the label takes it from there)
mutants.cases: render: what each kind of pass*

mutants.what: 15.3 (1): a frame's timings are not named by PassLabel
15.3 (3): a frame's timings start as recorded (before the adapter records anything)
15.8 (M1): a timing begun over the last frame's keeps a pass's CPU time
15.3 (2), 15.8 (M1): the debug groups are counted across frames, not per frame (merges tm-groups-carried-over)
15.3 (5): the frame number does not go up per frame recorded (the first frame is then none)
15.3 (3): a pass with no target this frame (not mapped) is reported as recorded
mutants.find: void BeginFrame(const R::RenderCommands& commands) { BeginTiming(timing, ++framesRecorded, commands); }

mutants.what: 15.3 (3): a recorded pass is not reported as recorded
15.3 (3): a recorded pass's CPU time is not measured
15.8 (S2): a pass's CPU time counted from another moment than its recording's start (the clock's epoch)
15.3 (2): a recorded pass gets no debug group
15.8 (N4, M2): a frame recorded without its timing begun (the passes and their timings out of step)
mutants.expect: a frame's timing has one entry per pass it records

mutants.what: 15.8 (M3): before any frame the device gives a timing (of no frame) instead of none
15.3 (4): a frame handed to the GPU does not keep its fence (no GPU time, on the window or in a Capture; was tm-capture-not-tracked)

15.3 (4), 15.9: within is not the time from the handing to the look that saw the frame done
